# source: xspace documentation (\xspace: a space unless the next token is in
# the exception list of punctuation). Implemented as lookahead in the
# rewrite walk; at a group or macro-body end, where the use site is
# unknowable at rewrite time, the space (the package's default action) is
# emitted. Before punctuation the package's action is to emit nothing, which
# the engine reports as a construct read with no effect (W0387) — the
# exception list working, said out loud rather than passed off as ink.
body impl a\xspace b
body refuse:W0387 a\xspace.
